classes.HARD_CLOCK: technical/prewar physical clock kept unless resource allocation changes fielding
classes.SOFT_TRIGGER: maturity date recalculated from observed evidence, need and capacity
classes.POLICY: decision reopened at the relevant strategic/industrial gate
classes.SERVICE_CAPABILITY: capability already partially present in one service; do not model as a universal future switch
classes.OPERATIONAL_DOCTRINE: scenario-level mission allocation preference; changes only from observed enemy/own state and command demand
classes.OUTCOME_GATE: later historical result explicitly reopened; not a capability switch

switches.rule: post-opening aircraft/engine/equipment fielding quantities are outputs of production, attrition, repair, engine allocation, spares and deployment; retain physical development clocks but do not inherit later fixed quantities from FORAGER-era ledgers
allocate individual boats among fleet interception, reconnaissance, minelaying, midget support, commerce raiding and invasion screening; allocation is a scenario state, not a fixed national trait

apply Hull→Availability→Mission from opening to all surface combatants; do not wait until later carrier-era audits

carry repair clocks, ammunition/fuel and crew state across sequential and parallel operations
withdraw former assumption that 1942-43 rerun remains fixed and 1944-06-10 is a safe continuation point; recompute sequentially from opening

destroyer/carrier/cruiser build and conversion decisions formerly conditioned on no Guadalcanal-style losses are reopened and triggered by actual rerun losses, escort burden, air-group survival and industrial capacity
do not auto-apply historical or former-branch conversions to surviving old hulls; compare active, minor refit, mission conversion, reserve, training/test and retirement
retain 1943 Mutsu accident as exogenous centerline unless a relevant causal change is established; keep survival sensitivity branch and do not treat as policy switch
monthly fleet roster is an index, not an exact Dec 7/8 operational snapshot; verify commissioning, location, repair and actual task per hull

do not apply old +15-25% first-line effective output or +20-35% repetitive land-air output as scenario input; derive sortie/reach/return/serviceability from component states and use old bands only as external diagnostic priors

notes: IJA and IJN air-ground separation clocks are service-specific.
natural return is a continuous state transition from opening, not a 1942 switch.
old calendar dates for later organizational maturity remain reset until evidence/capacity/need/time gates are satisfied.
Malaya mission allocation is tracked as operational doctrine, not dogfight micro-tactics.
First-generation wartime standard ship is an opening committed pipeline, not an opening completed-tonnage bonus.
Cryptographic design/audit capability is separated from the historical outcome of what the enemy learns in time.
Dedicated escort construction priority is reopened; pre-existing escort staff capacity is retained separately.
Doc47 remains useful as a HARD technology audit format, but its MI-start historical rerun gate is superseded by the opening-state rerun.
